Circuit diagrams illustrating the three most relevant pathways influenced by miR-128–3p

Circuit diagrams illustrating the three most relevant pathways influenced by miR-128–3p. These include dopaminergic synapse, cortisol synthesis, and axon guidance. These pathways are central to neuropsychiatric disorders, such as mood regulation and neurodegeneration. Each diagram shows the genes targeted by miR-128–3p in red, underscoring its potential role in modulating signaling pathways critical for neuronal function and dysfunction in the brain
Download JPG
View figure at PMC Read paper at PMC

Publication

MicroRNA-128–3p as a promising target in neuropsychiatric disorders: From epigenetics to pharmacological intervention (2025) Anuj K. Verma, et al. Biomed Pharmacother. 2025 Oct;191(NA). Figure: F8.
